_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

0EE2.name: BattTempHeatFactor
0EE2.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into $0A5B,Z

4064.name: ResetCoolantInit
4064.desc: At reset: $0C00,Z against start coolant temperature

4094.name: CrankEthanolScale
4094.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

048F.name: PartThrottleMapScale
048F.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0483.name: DecelMapScale
0483.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

0F9F.name: FlexEthanolScale
0F9F.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content ($0198,Z) to the scaled value $0A91,Z used as table input

0F87.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0F87.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0F93.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0F93.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

04CB.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
04CB.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

42CC.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
42CC.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

42C2.name: PurgeFuelRpm
42C2.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

4118.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
4118.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

04BF.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
04BF.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

04D7.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
04D7.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

04EF.name: MisfireCoolantLoadScale
04EF.desc: Load to row position of MisfireThreshCoolant

049B.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
049B.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

051F.name: IacRollThrottleScale
051F.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

04B3.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
04B3.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

4333.name: IacFieldDutyScale
4333.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

433F.name: IacBaroScale
433F.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IacBaseBaroTarget2

058A.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
058A.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into $076B,Z

05BC.name: CrankBasePulse
05BC.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content ($0A91,Z, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into $0766,Z

055A.name: CrankRpmDecay
055A.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0564.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0564.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

057A.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
057A.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant

0582.name: CrankV0769Decay
0582.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against $0769,Z; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0533.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0533.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

059B.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
059B.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into $0765,Z

063D.name: CrankCoolantAdder
063D.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events ($0C44,Z), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant $0768,Z

0646.name: InjectorDeadTime
0646.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

1466.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
1466.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse ($0780,Z / $0782,Z) during the change of injection mode in Sub_112A8

07C2.name: PartThrottleFuel
07C2.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0E5D.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E5D.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0A0E.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0A0E.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor ($077A,Z) in

19FB.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
19FB.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while $0D02,Z bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0715.name: WotFuel
0715.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0EB0.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
0EB0.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

0440.name: ResetCoolantFuelInit
0440.desc: At reset: $07C4,Z (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant

0FA9.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
0FA9.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into $07C0,Z

0FBB.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
0FBB.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into $07BF,Z

0F73.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
0F73.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast ($0A7F,Z) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

0F64.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
0F64.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

0F7B.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
0F7B.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is $07C2,Z

0FCD.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
0FCD.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

0FE1.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
0FE1.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

0FF5.name: DecelLeanAirflow
0FF5.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to $0804,Z

1091.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
1091.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into $07C1,Z

0F19.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
0F19.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set

12C8.name: O2VoltageScale2
12C8.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1186.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1186.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag ($0770,Z bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

140F.name: PurgeFuelBase
140F.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value $07EB,Z

1679.name: CoolantSparkMap
1679.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed

1AF1.name: AirTempSparkFactor
1AF1.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or $0A5A,Z with calibration bit $0330.5 clear)

1A9C.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1A9C.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1A09.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1A09.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into $0D1B,Z

1940.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1940.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

19E5.name: DecelSpark
19E5.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

19F3.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
19F3.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1D31.name: EventSparkThrottle
1D31.desc: Upper limit of the event spark $0859,Z against throttle while $0856,Z bits 4 and 2 are set (raised by $205D per loop)

1D3B.name: EventSparkThrottle2
1D3B.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while $0856,Z bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

1BA3.name: SurgeJerkRetardOpen
1BA3.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: retard against positive rpm jerk (above $2173)

1BAB.name: SurgeJerkAdvanceOpen
1BAB.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: spark against negative rpm jerk (below $2172)

1BDB.name: SurgeRateThreshold
1BDB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm acceleration ($0D26,Z) that starts the retard, against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BE9.name: SurgeRetardGearFactor
1BE9.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the base retard against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BC3.name: SurgeRetardRateFactor
1BC3.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against rpm acceleration $0D26,Z

1BCF.name: SurgeRetardMapRiseFactor
1BCF.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against MAP rise $0D3B,Z (MAP minus filtered MAP); result into $0D33,Z

1B5E.name: SurgeDecay
1B5E.desc: Driveline surge spark control: decay factor of the retard against gear (rows) and time in the decay stage $0D37,Z (columns)

1BF7.name: SurgeJerkThreshold
1BF7.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm jerk ($0D30,Z) above which the jerk retard applies, against the rpm/speed ratio

1B97.name: SurgeRetardCoolantFactor
1B97.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against coolant

1B1C.name: SurgeJerkGain
1B1C.desc: Driveline surge spark control: jerk retard gain against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns)

1AFB.name: SurgeJerkLimit
1AFB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: limit of the jerk retard against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns), into $0D36,Z

1C41.name: AcSparkRateUp
1C41.desc: A/C spark compensation: spark against positive rpm rate $0D4A,Z, into $0D55,Z

1C49.name: AcSparkRateDown
1C49.desc: As AcSparkRateUp against negative rpm rate, A/C clutch off

1C51.name: AcSparkRateDownAcOn
1C51.desc: As AcSparkRateDown with the A/C clutch on

1C59.name: AcSparkMapLimit
1C59.desc: Limit of the A/C spark compensation against MAP

16D6.name: FlexSparkMapRpm
16D6.desc: Flex-fuel spark change, MAP x rpm, minus $0D03,Z, weighted by FlexSparkEthanolWeight

1A42.name: FlexSparkEthanolWeight
1A42.desc: Weight of FlexSparkMapRpm against ethanol content

1CA3.name: KnockThreshold
1CA3.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

1CBC.name: KnockRetardStep
1CBC.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold ($0A8B,Z minus KnockThresholdNow)

1CB3.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CB3.desc: Maximum knock retard ($0DAA,Z) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

1ADB.name: AirTempSparkFactor2
1ADB.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMap against intake air temperature

1AE5.name: AirTempSparkMap
1AE5.desc: Second air-temperature spark term against MAP (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor2

1F4E.name: IacGearDelayCoolant
1F4E.desc: Delay timer ($0349,Z) started when $0C31,Z bit 7 sets, against coolant

1F62.name: IacGearTimeFactor
1F62.desc: Factor on IacGearTimeCoolant against the time counter $0348,Z

1F6C.name: IacDroopStepCoolant
1F6C.desc: IAC opening when the rpm drops below the target in gear ($0317,Z bit 3, $0C31,Z bit 7), against coolant

1F7E.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPNAC
1F7E.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N with A/C requested

1F88.name: IacGearTimeFactorPNAC
1F88.desc: As IacGearTimeFactor in P/N with A/C requested

1FA5.name: IacAcKickMap
1FA5.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch engages, against MAP (MAP latched into $0341,Z); into $0340,Z

1FAD.name: IacAcKickMapLatched
1FAD.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch releases, against the MAP latched at engagement ($0341,Z)

1FC7.name: IacRunTimeAdder
1FC7.desc: IAC addition against time since start

1FCF.name: IacCoastCoolant
1FCF.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against coolant; the higher of this and IacCoastSpeedRpm applies

1FDD.name: IacCoastThrottleLimit
1FDD.desc: Throttle opening limit for the coasting idle air

2069.name: IacRollSpeedBase
2069.desc: IAC target while rolling: base against vehicle speed

2075.name: IacRollFactorAcSensor
2075.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against the filtered A/C sensor $0345,Z (centred on 128), with calibration bit $0331.7

2081.name: IacRollFactorBattTemp
2081.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against battery temperature (centred on 128)

208B.name: IacRollRpmFactor2
208B.desc: Second rolling IAC factor against segment rpm

2095.name: IacRollRpmFactor
2095.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against segment rpm

209F.name: IacRollThrottleRpm
209F.desc: IAC target while rolling: addition against throttle (rows) and segment rpm (signed); result into $0366,Z limited by $2642

1FE7.name: IacCoastSpeedRpm
1FE7.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against vehicle speed (rows) and segment rpm

21E8.name: IacStepBaroFactor
21E8.desc: Multiplier on IAC steps and start positions against barometric pressure

21F2.name: IacShiftBaroFactor
21F2.desc: Multiplier on the gear-change IAC step and the initial IAC value against barometric pressure

21FC.name: IacKickBaroFactor
21FC.desc: Factor on the A/C and rpm-dip IAC steps against barometric pressure

2044.name: IacFieldDutyRpm
2044.desc: IAC addition against field duty (rows) and segment rpm (columns), into $F4,Z

2109.name: IacFieldDutyRpm2
2109.desc: Second field-duty table against segment rpm, into $F7,Z (MAP offset for the learned idle MAP)

21B5.name: IdleMapBase
21B5.desc: Base of the idle MAP target ($031E,Z, via $F5,Z): barometric pressure (rows) and idle target rpm (columns)

21AD.name: IacStartBaro
21AD.desc: Idle air position at reset against barometric pressure, into $2A,Z

218C.name: IacBaseBaroTarget
218C.desc: Base idle air (IAC position) against barometric pressure (rows) and the idle target (columns), into $0362,Z; added to the IAC target

0507.name: MisfireWeightLoadScale
0507.desc: Load to row position of MisfireWeight

27D5.name: MisfireThresh
27D5.desc: Misfire threshold of the segment-time change against load (rows) and segment rpm $05C6,Z (columns), P/N

288F.name: MisfireThreshNoisy
288F.desc: As MisfireThresh when the filtered change $05D4,Z is at or above MisfireNoiseRef

26FA.name: MisfireWeight
26FA.desc: Counter weight of a detected misfire ($04FE,Z) against load (rows) and segment rpm (columns)

2757.name: MisfireWeight2
2757.desc: Second counter weight ($04FF,Z) against the first weight and segment rpm

27B4.name: MisfireThreshCoolant
27B4.desc: Factor on the misfire threshold against load (rows) and coolant (columns), result into $05E2,Z

26BA.name: MisfireHoldSegRpm
26BA.desc: Hold-off after a detected misfire ($0629,Z) against segment rpm

3DCD.name: MapLimpFromThrottle
3DCD.desc: Substitute MAP from the throttle position when the MAP sensor has failed

4024.name: ThermistorCold
4024.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

4034.name: ThermistorHot
4034.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

4088.name: AcSensorCurve
4088.desc: A/C sensor (probably refrigerant pressure): ADC $0A87,Z to $0A88,Z

409C.name: DwellRpmScale
409C.desc: Rpm to column position of DwellTime

40B0.name: DwellVoltsScale
40B0.desc: Battery voltage to row position of DwellTime

40C4.name: DwellTime
40C4.desc: Coil dwell against battery voltage and rpm (both as positions)

51E1.name: EventTimingLimit
51E1.desc: Output-compare set-up in the GPT IC1 interrupt: limit against $0D11,Z compared with $0ABE,Z

51F3.name: FuelEventOffset
51F3.desc: Per-event fuel offset against the calibration value $0A83 (or $7563 with bit $0338.2), added before the per-cylinder table $ABC3

031D.name: Options032A
031D.desc: Option byte; bit tests in the reference-event and spark code (bits 7-6: spark cap and ignition variants)

0325.name: Options0339
0325.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

031E.name: Options0331
031E.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0323.name: Options0337
0323.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0326.name: Options033A
0326.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0356.name: MtvRpmLow
0356.desc: Manifold tune valve (MtvTiming): lower switch rpm (word; $FF00 = off)

0358.name: MtvRpmHigh
0358.desc: Manifold tune valve: upper switch rpm (word)

035A.name: MtvRpmRateMin
035A.desc: Manifold tune valve: rpm change per period ($0C08,Z) at or above which the switch time is predicted

035C.name: MtvDelay1
035C.desc: Manifold tune valve: first actuator delay taken off the predicted switch time (word)

035E.name: MtvDelay2
035E.desc: Manifold tune valve: second actuator delay (word)

0360.name: MtvDelay3
0360.desc: Manifold tune valve: third actuator delay (word)

0362.name: MtvPeriod
0362.desc: Manifold tune valve: passes per prediction step ($0C03,Z; also the start value at reset and the time factor in Sub_2FA10)

0363.name: MtvRpmRateMax
0363.desc: Manifold tune valve: upper limit of the rpm change per period (word)

0365.name: MtvCoolantMin
0365.desc: Manifold tune valve: coolant at or above this value (at WOT) for the rpm switching

03A5.name: FanAcSensorStage1
03A5.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or above this value sets stage bit 1

03A6.name: FanAcSensorLow
03A6.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or below this value starts the low-pressure delay

03A7.name: FanAcSensorStage3
03A7.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or above this value sets stage bit 3

03A8.name: FanAcSensorStage2
03A8.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor above this value sets stage bit 2

03D0.name: IacHotCoolantMin
03D0.desc: Coolant above which the hot-engine IAC handling of Sub_19808 applies

0402.name: IacLowRpm
0402.desc: Segment rpm below which the low-rpm branch of Sub_19808 applies

0404.name: AcCutRpmLow
0404.desc: A/C logic: engine rpm limit used in Sub_19808 and Sub_39412 (FF00 = off)

0407.name: IacStartTimeMin
0407.desc: Time since start before the event logic of Sub_19808 runs

0408.name: IacEventTimerInit
0408.desc: Value of the IAC event timer $0C24,Z when the gear-change IAC starts

052F.desc: Word compared with V0ABD; read by Isr_GPT_IC1.
052F.name: EventV0ABDThresh1

0531.desc: Word compared with V0ABD; read by Isr_GPT_IC1.
0531.name: EventV0ABDThresh2

053F.name: CrankCoolantFloor
053F.desc: Cranking fuel: CrankCoolant is raised to at least this value while the throttle is not closed

0540.name: CrankClearFloodThrottle
0540.desc: Cranking: throttle above this value clears the cranking pulse (clear flood)

0597.name: FuelEventCoolantMax
0597.desc: Per-event fuel: the coolant correction of Sub_12680 applies below this coolant

0598.name: FuelEventColdOffset
0598.desc: Per-event fuel (Sub_12680): value minus 110 gives the cold correction step

0599.name: FuelEventColdOffset2
0599.desc: Per-event fuel: second value minus 110 used below FuelEventCoolantMax

059A.name: FuelEventOffsetInAlt
059A.desc: As FuelEventOffsetIn with calibration bit $0338.2 set

0645.name: CrankFuelCoolantMax
0645.desc: Cranking fuel: coolant above which the crank-event count is not used

0656.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0656.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

0657.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
0657.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0654.name: WotFuelK
0654.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0655.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0655.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

1463.name: FuelEventCoolantMin
1463.desc: Per-event fuel (Sub_112A8): runs above this coolant with the throttle not closed

1464.name: FuelEventRpmAboveIdle
1464.desc: Per-event fuel: engine rpm above the idle target by less than this value

1488.name: HotEngineOn
1488.desc: Hot-engine enrichment switch (0 = off); also a bit mask in Sub_11BE4

0E54.name: DecelRampStart
0E54.desc: Decel fuel reduction (Sub_104AE): starts when the drop sum is at or below this value

0E55.name: DecelRampStartHyst
0E55.desc: Hysteresis on DecelRampStart while active ($0776,Z bit 5)

0E56.name: DecelRampMin
0E56.desc: Decel fuel reduction: start value of DecelFuelRamp

0E57.name: DecelRampMax
0E57.desc: Decel fuel reduction: upper limit of DecelFuelRamp

0E58.name: DecelRampRpmMin
0E58.desc: Decel fuel reduction: below this rpm the ramp starts at DecelRampMin

0E59.name: DecelRampStepTime
0E59.desc: Decel fuel reduction: time between steps up ($0777,Z)

0E5A.name: DecelRampStep
0E5A.desc: Decel fuel reduction: step up of DecelFuelRamp

0E5B.name: DecelRampStepTimeDown
0E5B.desc: Decel fuel reduction: time between steps down

0E5C.name: DecelRampStepDown
0E5C.desc: Decel fuel reduction: step down of DecelFuelRamp

070A.name: O2FlexEthanolMin
070A.desc: Closed loop: ethanol content below which $0770,Z bit 2 is set (flex fuel)

070B.name: O2FlexOffsetStep
070B.desc: Flex trim offset: step of $19,X while it is positive or zero

070C.name: O2FlexOffsetStepNeg
070C.desc: Flex trim offset: step of $19,X while it is negative (limited to zero)

0711.desc: Byte used with; read by Sub_15FF4.
0711.name: SensorValue4

0714.desc: Byte used with; read by Sub_15FF4.
0714.name: SensorValue5

070D.name: O2FlexCellMask
070D.desc: Flex trim offset (O2FlexOffset): bit map of the O2 cells (bit n = cell n) whose offset $19,X is stepped with high ethanol

0EBD.name: AccelMapRiseOffset
0EBD.desc: MAP acceleration fuel: MAP rise (MAP minus MapLast) above this offset counts

0F5E.name: DecelLeanMapDrop
0F5E.desc: Decel enleanment: MAP drop (MapLast minus MAP) that keeps $07BB,Z bit 2

0F5F.name: DecelLeanThrottleDrop
0F5F.desc: Decel enleanment: throttle drop that keeps $07BB,Z bit 0

0F60.name: DecelLeanTimerMin
0F60.desc: Decel enleanment ends when DecelLeanTimer is at or below this value

0F61.name: DecelLeanGain
0F61.desc: Decel enleanment: gain on the MAP/throttle drop, in gear

0F6C.name: DecelLeanSpeedMin
0F6C.desc: Decel enleanment runs at or above this vehicle speed

0F6D.name: DecelLeanRpmMin
0F6D.desc: Decel enleanment runs at or above this engine rpm

0F6E.name: FuelPulseMode
0F6E.desc: Fuel pulse output mode; 11 selects the second branch of Sub_1202A

0F70.name: DecelLeanDropMin
0F70.desc: Throttle drop at or above which the timed enleanment starts

0F71.name: DecelLeanRpmMargin
0F71.desc: Decel enleanment runs while rpm is above idle target plus this margin

1297.name: O2PurgeRampMin
1297.desc: Closed loop: purge ramp at or above which the purge correction of the trim applies

1234.name: O2DerivGainDefault
1234.desc: O2 feedback: derivative gain $15,X loaded when the gains come from the cell tables

12AB.name: O2PropGain
12AB.desc: O2 feedback (O2DownTrim): gain of the proportional term $0E,X (error × gain × 4 / 51, limited to ±127)

12AC.name: O2TrimMax
12AC.desc: Short-term trim upper limit (128 = no correction)

129C.name: O2IntegralHighFlag
129C.desc: O2 feedback: integral term $0C,X (word) above this value counts as saturated high

129E.name: O2IntegralLowFlag
129E.desc: O2 feedback: integral term below this (signed) value counts as saturated low

129B.name: O2SlowStepPeriod
129B.desc: O2 feedback: period ($12,X) between steps of the slow term $11,X while the integral is saturated (also used by ClosedLoopManager, ClosedLoopTiming, O2SwitchState)

2316.name: O2SlowMinNew
2316.desc: O2 feedback: lower (signed) limit of the slow term for a new vehicle

2317.name: O2SlowMaxNew
2317.desc: O2 feedback: upper limit of the slow term for a new vehicle

1299.name: O2SlowMin
1299.desc: O2 feedback: lower (signed) limit of the slow term

129A.name: O2SlowMax
129A.desc: O2 feedback: upper limit of the slow term

11AA.name: O2WarmDelayCoolant
